document.about: Cree Lighting CR4T downlight spec sheet (Canada). Page 1 sets its specification rows on alternating grey bands beside a line drawing of the fixture; page 2 a column of headed bullet lists beside a polar candela chart drawn as whole circles clipped to a quarter.

notes: #114: the grey bands carried the rows' words, and grouped with the fixture drawing beside them they made one drawing of the page's text: the headings, the description and all ten rows were typed doco:Figure.
#116: the chart's outer circles were measured whole, reaching off the page and across the text column, and the column's headings and bullets were typed as the chart's labels.

checks.issue: `Performance Summary`, set over the grey bands, was typed as a drawing's label.
A specification row on a grey band was typed as a drawing's label.
The description paragraph, too wide to be a label, was typed doco:Figure because it lay inside the box around the drawing's labels.

element.text: The new CR4T LED downlight delivers 790 lumens while achieving over 75 lumens per watt. This breakthrough performance is achieved by combining the high efficacy and high-quality 90 CRI light. The CR4T is available in 3000K, 3500K and 4000K color temperatures, and easily installs into most standard four-inch recessed IC or non-IC housings.

checks.issue: The text column's headings were typed as labels of the candela chart, whose clipped circles reached across them.
As above, for the column's bullets, which kept their `•`.

element.text: Suitable for insulated and non-insulated ceilings
